ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level contrast ratio; the visible ventral surface is dominated by low-intensity (black) pixels with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized peripheral regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of a contiguous dark pigmentation region. High-contrast white blobs are mapped to the distal margins, specifically at the far right fluke tip and sparsely along the left trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central notch with a deep indentation depth relative to the fluke lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serration map. Left lobe trailing edge exhibits medium-frequency, high-amplitude peaks (jagged); right lobe trailing edge exhibits higher-frequency, lower-amplitude serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave sweep trajectory from the medial notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacles) on the terminal edge of the right lobe; minor scattered white spots on the left lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single faint, vertical linear pixel disruption is visible on the inner-mid section of the right fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical trauma evidenced by irregular indentations and 'missing' segments along the trailing edge of both lobes; presence of ectoparasitic scarring (barnacles) on the right fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced, irregular jagged notch located on the medial-distal boundary of the left lobe trailing edge.
